title: Chunk, Align, Select: A Simple Long-sequence Processing Method for Transformers

layout.note: Left, bottom-up: the encoder input strip with a brace, chunked rows, a grey Encoder Layers band (self-attention boxes at its foot, BOS and EOS alignment boxes crossing its middle) and a light-blue Sequential Select band on top with a chain of three token selectors. At the right a yellow Decoder Layer column built bottom-up above the decoder input, a thin Selected Tokens strip between the two, and a long feedback line running along the top edge.

lesson: Show token-level mechanics by carrying one colour per chunk through every row of numbered squares and singling out special tokens (grey start, white end) so coloured arrow bundles can show how information crosses chunks; put the new operations in white boxes with coloured outlines on tinted bands.
